hints.text: Hint: Achievements are rare here. That's what makes them achievements.
Did you know? Looking at something far away for twenty seconds rests your eyes.
Tip: The map isn't the place.
Tip: The cat will come to you. Don't force it.
Tip: Go outside. The graphics are incredible.
Tip: Not everyone in the tavern wants to talk. Respect that.
Tip: You can talk your way out of most fights.
Tip: Some chests bite. Most don't.
Lore: The library shuts at dusk, but the lights stay on.
Tip: A goat can climb anything. You can't.
Tip: Rain makes everything look better.
Tip: Sleep at the inn. Your back will thank you.
Hint: Nobody has ever got to 100% on the first try.
Tip: Your progress is only saved if you watch until the end.
Tip: You can always come back for it later. You won't, but you can.
Hint: You've seen this hint before. Or you will.
Lore: The ferryman counts every passenger. The numbers never match.
Tip: Armour is heavy. So is regret.
Did you know? Your brain fills in the picture before the save finishes.
Lore: There was once a save that never finished. They still talk about it.
Tip: Rest when you can. The feed will still be there.
Lore: Every winter someone tries to cross the lake. Every winter the lake wins.
Hint: Count the saves. Something happens at a round number.
Tip: Take the long way home once in a while.
Lore: The tower has always been a little bit too tall.
Lore: The bridge troll retired years ago. The sign is still up.
Did you know? There's a seed behind every save. Same seed, same video.
Lore: The old king saved every night and never once loaded.
Tip: Never split the party. Unless it's a big party.
Tip: Old friends are a good save point.
Tip: The ghost wants its ring back. Just give it the ring.
Tip: The top floor is always where they keep the good stuff.
Tip: If it's too quiet, it's a trap. Or it's just quiet.
Hint: Some of these hints are true.
Hint: The tips are different every time. Most of them, anyway.
Tip: Turning it off and on again still works.
Tip: Look up once in a while.
Tip: You'll get it next time. That's what next time is for.
Lore: The guards change shift at midnight. Nobody has ever seen them do it.
Tip: Sit up straight. Your character can't, but you can.
Did you know? Nobody actually knows what the 99% is doing.
Hint: The saves aren't in any order. Or they are and you haven't noticed.
Tip: The music changes when something's coming.
Tip: Dragons hoard gold because they don't trust banks.
Tip: Being stuck usually means you're close.
Tip: Frogs know things. Don't ask them.
Hint: The rain at the end is the same rain as the start.
Tip: Breathe in for four, out for six.
Tip: Try sneaking. The worst that happens is a fight.
Lore: The apprentice makes the best swords. Nobody tells the blacksmith.
Tip: Some doors are just painted on.
Tip: Not every hill needs climbing.
Lore: Nobody remembers who built the first save point. It was just there one day.
Lore: The mapmaker drew a dragon in the corner. Then one moved in.
Hint: The memory always comes last. Patience pays.
Tip: You're allowed to start again.
Tip: Nobody likes the ice level. Just get through it.
Tip: Pigeons have nowhere to be and still look busy.
Hint: If the bar goes backwards, close your eyes and count to ten.
Tip: It's alright to play on easy.
Lore: The save point in the forest is older than the forest.
Tip: The boss has a pattern. So do you.
Tip: If the boss is too hard, go and level up somewhere quiet.
Tip: You've watched this far. You may as well stay.
Tip: You can't carry everything. Most of it was junk anyway.
Tip: Hit the wall. Hollow walls sound different.
Tip: Crows remember faces. Be nice to crows.
Tip: Some quests only turn up when you stop looking for them.
Tip: Blink. Screens make you forget.
Tip: Bridges look safer than they are.
Tip: You don't lose anything by looking at the map.
Tip: Say thank you to the bus driver.
Tip: Skip the cutscene if you like. Nobody's checking.
Hint: The memory doesn't lie. It just leaves things out.
Tip: You can save without finishing.
Tip: Enemies can't climb ladders. Usually.
Lore: The castle has a room with no door. The window is lit at night.
Tip: Don't trust a chest in an empty room.
Tip: Please don't touch the screen. Or do. It's your screen.
Tip: Every NPC has somewhere they'd rather be.
Tip: Slimes are mostly harmless. Mostly.
Tip: You should pet the dog.
Tip: Some bosses only want to be left alone.
Lore: The first player saved in a field. The field is still there.
Hint: Somewhere in here is a hint that's actually useful.
Tip: Doors that need three keys usually lead to a fourth door.
Hint: The playtime is real. Don't ask whose.
Tip: The tutorial was the easy bit. Sorry.
Tip: Ducks are always watching. They mean well.
Tip: Turn the brightness down after midnight.
Did you know? Some games hide their loading inside a long lift ride.
Tip: The ending isn't the point. Probably.
Tip: Healing items are for using, not hoarding.
Tip: That potion you're saving for the right moment. This might be it.
Tip: The best loot is usually at the end of the long way round.
Did you know? A memory card held about fifteen saves, if you were careful.
Did you know? Saving used to mean waiting. It still does, a bit.
Did you know? This video ends exactly where it started.
Tip: Not every sound is an enemy.
Tip: Eat something that didn't come out of a packet.
Tip: Invisible walls are there to keep you safe. From what, nobody says.
Tip: Bring a torch. Bring two.
Tip: Strafing is just walking sideways with confidence.
Did you know? Your thumb has scrolled a long way today.
Lore: The clock tower stopped at 4:12 and nobody ever wound it again.
Tip: Break every pot. Someone has to.
Tip: Nobody ever regretted an early night.
Tip: The fog hides more than it shows.
Tip: The wizard is late. Wizards are always late.
Tip: You can skip the dialogue. Or you could listen for once.
Tip: Bards will write a song about anything. Be careful what you do.
Tip: When in doubt, ask the old man by the well.
Tip: The person next to you might fancy a cup of tea.
Tip: Never trust a merchant who's pleased to see you.
Tip: Press nothing for a moment and see what happens.
Tip: Cooked food heals more than raw. Ask anyone.
Did you know? Old cartridges kept your save alive with a tiny battery.
Tip: Drop your shoulders. There, that's better.
Tip: Don't sell the thing you don't understand yet.
Tip: Statues that blink are not statues.
Hint: You can watch it again. It loops for you.
Tip: Saving often never hurt anyone.
Tip: Talk to everyone in town twice.
Tip: Your progress is precious. Be gentle with it.
Tip: Jumping on things solves more problems than it should.
Did you know? The darker the spot, the heavier the character.
Tip: Charge your phone before you need to.
Lore: The ghost in the east wing is mostly just lonely.
Tip: Mushrooms in caves are not lunch.
Tip: You don't have to finish every side quest.
Tip: Sell the rusty sword. You're not going back for it.
Lore: The inn has thirteen rooms. The key rack has fourteen hooks.
Tip: A suspiciously good sword is suspicious for a reason.
Tip: Keep a notebook. Ideas don't save themselves.
Tip: When in doubt, go left.
Tip: Fast travel is lovely, but you miss things.
Tip: Not all progress shows up on a bar.
Tip: Keep the receipt.
Did you know? Old televisions gave off a high whine only some people could hear.
Tip: Moths are just butterflies who work nights.
Tip: Turn the subtitles on. You've been missing half the jokes.
Did you know? This hint was chosen just for you. It wasn't, but it's a nice thought.
Tip: Take your time. This isn't a speedrun.
Tip: Text them back. You've been meaning to.
Hint: No save loads the same way twice.
Lore: The lighthouse keeper still lights it. Nobody's told her the ships stopped.
Tip: Back up the photos. You know the ones.
Tip: Go to bed. The internet will keep.
Tip: Put your phone face down for a bit after this.
Hint: This save is one of many. Keep scrolling and you'll find another.
Tip: If a stranger offers you a quest, at least ask what it pays.
Did you know? Some early save files were smaller than this sentence.
Tip: There's always one more room.
Lore: The merchant doesn't know where he gets his stock either.
Tip: Check behind the waterfall.
Tip: Stopping for a bit isn't quitting.
Did you know? You've made it past the first three seconds. Most people don't.
Tip: It's later than you think. It always is.
Tip: The thing you lost is under the sofa.
Tip: Hum along. Nobody can hear you.
Did you know? Loading screens are there so the game can think. You're allowed to as well.
Hint: Watch the last second. Then watch the first one again.
Hint: This one doesn't help. The next one might.
Tip: Leave the campfire going. Someone else might need it.
Tip: Nobody plays it the way the guide says.
Hint: The bar always sticks at 99%. Nobody knows why.
Tip: The chicken is stronger than it looks. Leave it alone.
Tip: Nobody has it all figured out. Not even the wise old man.
Lore: There was a hero here once. The statue is better looking.
Lore: The cartographer never finished the map. He kept moving the edge.
Tip: Stretch. Your legs have been loading too.
Tip: If you're reading this, it's working.
Tip: Write the code down. You'll forget it.
Lore: Somebody keeps leaving flowers at the save point by the gate.
Lore: Nobody in the village has seen the sea. They talk about it anyway.
Tip: Water the plants. They've been patient.
Tip: Footsteps that stop when you stop are worth noting.
Lore: Every slot used to belong to somebody.
Did you know? One frame of this video holds more characters than a page of a novel.
Tip: The village fool knows where the treasure is.
Tip: If you get lost, follow the river.
Tip: Owls aren't wise. They're just quiet.
Did you know? This save took longer to make than it does to watch.
Tip: The red barrel is red for a reason.
Did you know? You blink less when you look at a screen.
Lore: The tavern sign has been repainted eleven times. It's still spelt wrong.
Tip: Take the stairs. The lift isn't coming.
Tip: Ring your mum. Or whoever you'd ring.
Tip: Read the sign again. It might say something different this time.
Tip: Unclench your jaw.
Tip: Scrolling away now will not save your progress.
Lore: The well in the square is deeper than anyone has measured.
Tip: Grinding is just patience with a sword.
Did you know? People made pictures out of typed characters long before screens.
Tip: Read the item descriptions. Someone worked hard on them.
Did you know? You've been holding your phone the same way for a while now.
Lore: The old road goes somewhere. Nobody's walked far enough to find out.
Tip: Losing is just saving with extra steps.
Tip: Some days are just loading screens. That's fine.
Tip: There's no shame in looking it up.
Tip: If a door won't open, it's probably not your door yet.
Tip: The strange noise in the cellar is probably fine.
Lore: The children's rhyme about the tower is a set of directions.
Tip: An empty room is rarely empty.
Lore: The hermit came down the mountain once, bought bread, and went back up.
Did you know? Some old games gave you a password to write down instead of saving.
Tip: You're doing better than your stats say.
Tip: The washing's probably done.
Tip: Yellow paint usually means you can climb it.
Hint: Read the journal if you want. It goes further.
Did you know? A floppy disk holds 1.44 megabytes. This video is bigger.
Tip: Every lever does something. Some of them do something bad.
Lore: The last save in this slot was made in the rain.
Tip: Hold the button down. Some things take a while.
Tip: Open a window for a bit.
Hint: The picture was always there. It just needed saving.
Lore: They say the save crystals hum when you're not looking.
Tip: The shopkeeper will still be there tomorrow.
Hint: There are more hints than saves. For now.
Tip: Tidy one thing. Just one.
Tip: Check your pockets before the wash.
Tip: Walking into walls sometimes works. Not often, but sometimes.
Tip: Come back at night. Things are different.
Tip: Mimics hate being called chests.
Hint: You missed something in the last save.
Tip: Don't turn off your phone. We did mention that.
Tip: Did you leave the hob on? Probably not. Go and check anyway.
Tip: The horse will find you. Give it a minute.
Tip: Drink some water.
Tip: Read the books on the shelves. One of them is real.
Tip: Put the kettle on. It's never a bad idea.
Tip: Saying no to a quest is allowed.
Tip: Some of the best saves are in the most boring places.
Tip: If it glows, it's probably important.
Tip: Some saves hide something. Keep your eyes open.
Tip: The snail gets there in the end. Be more snail.
Tip: Some of the townsfolk remember what you did.
Hint: The saves are numbered for a reason.
Tip: The thing you're looking for is in the last place you look.
